newsitem.title: USA: Omega Environmental files for Chapter 11.
newsitem.headline: Omega Environmental files for Chapter 11.

text.p: Omega Environmental Inc said Friday that it had filed a voluntary petition for protection under Chapter 11 with the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Western District of Washington.
The company, which provides products and services to the fueling facility industry, said operating under Chapter 11 will help it restructure its operations and financing arrangements.
It said its tangible assets exceed its liabilities by more than $20 million, but that it chose to seek protection to ensure adequate cash flow.
It said it is negotiating with lenders to obtain debtor-in-possession financing.
Omega said its plans include ceasing all its U.S. construction-related business activity, which it said has been a major drain of company resources.

"This filing is intended to preserve and enhance the company's continuing businesses, many of which are sound, and to ensure that these continuing operations which fit our growth strategy are adequately funded," a company statement said. "We believe the company will emerge from this process a leaner, stronger entity."
